message: time layout written with the strftime codes of C, Python, Ruby, and PHP (`%d`, `%m`, `%y`); Xo layouts use named, lowercase fields such as {year}-{month}-{day} (std.md 13.3)

notes.message: fields: {year} {month} {month:1} {month:short} {month:name} {day} {day:1} {weekday:short} {weekday:name} {hour} {hour12} {ampm} {minute} {second} {frac} {frac:3} {offset} {offset:compact} {zone}; a two digit year is not offered
